notes.title: alpha v.4 huge content update
notes.content:

-Map: added tons of new things to explore including icebergs.

STRUCTURES/BASE CAMP
-Astrophotography kit: dynamic way of collecting data.

-Camera traps

-new hardware welder model and props.
-new tent model
-new water deposit model.
-new sfx when placing structures.
-“unpacking process” after placing a structure the npc in charge has to unpack his equipment before being able to work.

STARTING A NEW GAME
-Choose expedition flag color
-Choose your specialty (geologist, biologist, and meteorologist) this will allow you to collect more data from some items/structures.
-improved dog naming process.

ITEMS
-Tissue/cell sample: get it from dead animals and algae.
-Camera sd: camera traps 

ANIMALS
-Walrus
-Seal
-Orca (rare spawns)

DATA SCANNER
-A new structure that allows you to retrieve data from items you find in the map, including damaged hard drives and skin samples.

PETITIONS/UPLOADING DATA
-Uploading data will now grant exposure which translates into signatures for your petitions to protect marine areas, a larger marine area under protection means a higher positive impact on the ecosystem.

CAMERA TRAPS
-Regular traps have been replaced by camera traps, small autonomous cameras that track the movement of animals. They must be placed close to dens, you can retrieve the camera SD every day and use a data scanner to convert it into data. 

SOLAR PANESL
-This is the new energy producing structure, they follow the sun and only generate power while the sun is up.

NPCS
- Distinct idle animation, improved interaction process. 

STARTING ZONE
-A radically improved starting area, npcs that provide tips and more.
- You can now send a pilot on recruitment trips by providing the food required for the new members.

OTHER
-Sled: sled will go slower when going uphill
-kayak: you can now use your kayak by simply standing close to water and pressing “E” 
-Added inventory menu animations
-updated help menu
-added special data collection areas
-added algae growing on thin ice in some areas around the island
-Each animal now gives a distinct amount of meat, and also animal cell samples. 

Some of the fixes:
-huge optimization improvement
-fixed input bug that was heavily affecting the game’s performance.
-fixed antialiasing/ssao bug that caused frame drops when getting too close to npcs or game objects.
-fixed seeing through objects if you were close enough (camera bug) 
-fixed color correction bug that was causing camera artifacts to appear on dark surfaces. 
-fixed water rendering before distant trees 
-fixed stars not rendering 
-fixed penguins not spawning when loading/continuing a game. 
-fixed penguins rotation bug
-fixed “Quit” menu button.
-Smaller, cleaner UI when interacting with expedition members. 
- fixed weather monitors and ice drills resource check bug.
-fixed co-op player animation system breaking after some time.

notes.title: alpha v.32 changelog
notes.content:
These are the major changes in alpha v.32

-The expedition update adds a new objective to the game “Data collection”, you will be able to place weather monitors, collect data from buoys in the open sea, and then upload this data to get different rewards (from critical items like med kits to items that will allow you to customize the look of your base)

-Added small intro

-Animal AI: deer, lion, wolf will now evade trees when they either chasing or running away from you.

-Npcs now have their own name and “efficiency” level, this affects how they perform the tasks assigned by the player. I.E a hunter with a high efficiency level will bring more meat after a hunting trip. 

-Npcs now sleep, this makes them unavailable for work at certain hours.
-You can now customize the look of your base by using paint buckets.

-Major improvements to the building process, now you are able to see how large structures will be placed and everything is more dynamic. 

-New structures: 

-Hardware welder (replaces metal gatherer, and hardware components replace the “metal” resource)
-Antenna: Allows you to upload data, an antenna is also required to start setting up a new base.
-Eco-ranger: Makes use of local data to go on eco-friendly campaigns which will improve the health of the ecosystem.
-Tent: cheap to build, allows you to sleep and save your game anywhere.
-Weather monitor, ice caps monitor: use them to gather data every dayl

-Storms no longer send you back in time, they will now wipe your resources and local data if you do not meet the demands. 

-New map with improved flow and balance. 

-Day/night transition system color palette revised and improved. 

-New ambient occlusion technique. 

-Player 2 is now able to build some structures, including: traps, weather and ice caps monitor, 

-Huge improvements to the UI.

-Penguins.

-You can now change between gun and tools by using keys 1,2,3,4,5

-Your arms and tools now take less space in the screen.

notes.content:

Small update:
 [*]Fixed bears and deers getting stuck on trees
 [*]Fixed opening your inventory while interacting with your dogs breaks the game
 [*]Added option to make trees load their 3d models from a longer distance (this should fix the trees popping up problem)
 [*]Now arrows have a 40% chance of breaking when they hit an animal
 [*]Fixed one the dogs was not spending energy when running
 [*]Fixed bread looting problem

notes.title: new update is live- alpha .105
notes.content:
The first update is live!

 [*]wildlife: added ducks
 [*]wildlife: bears now do twice the damage to dogs and you
 [*]shooting/hunting: now you can retrieve arrows from dead animals
 [*]shooting/hunting: bullet speed increased
 [*]dogs: now dogs restore part of their energy depending on the amount of hours you sleep
 [*]dogs: when one of your dogs die your game is saved
 [*]Map: added some kind of interior (furniture,trash) to 75% of the abandoned houses
 [*]Map: fixed most of the houses that look like they were dragged  by snow
 [*]Sleeping: you can now sleep/save your game in abandoned cars
 [*]FX: added a small wind fx to trees, their leaves will now move
 [*]FX: added a wind sfx 

The next update will be focused on fixing some of the bugs you have been reporting, then I will move on to a HUGE map focused update.

notes.title: Plans for the first update
notes.content: The first update will focus on house interiors, I will work to make the interior of the abandoned houses feel way more immersive. It should be up by this thursday or friday. Also I will fix some of the bugs you guys are reporting and probably work on the balancing side of the game, many players have reported that their dogs can kill a bear and that is not right. Also I will add more places where you can take shelter and sleep for the night. And the last thing you will be able to sleep in cars, but the risk of losing calories will be higher.

notes.title: Before launch!
notes.content:
So the day is almost here, on monday about at 10am PST our game will be launched! But before even thinking about buying the game there are some things you should know and do.

DO : watch gameplay videos on youtube (some examples below)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u2BCD8DJ0rs
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a7VYJtvv73A
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7_j1xtEox04&list=UUm3bguUljMFXN7qyxIVatrw

KNOW: 

Price : 9.99$ with initial 20% discount (7.99)

-This game is being developed by a single person (I will use whatever money the game makes to create a proper development team)
-The map is far from complete 
-Currently there is only one save slot 
-The dogs on the sled have animation problems when attacked while running 
-Animal AI needs a lot of work 
-The game needs a lot of work in the sound area, many sounds are still missing. 
-The game needs a drastic balancing, right now I feel it is too easy 
- Loot spawn is not yet completely random, the only loot that is randomly generated is the one you get from cars 
-The game needs some serious optimization 
-Changing the graphics settings can crash (now I have not experienced this problem, but a youtuber reported to be having problems whenever he changes the quality of the graphics) 
-the dog sled physics have some issues
